_comment: Approval, as a SEPARATE run-task invocation with an overridden command.
Why an override rather than a second task definition, or an env var:
* An env var in the task definition is true for every future execution.
The gate would be gone and nobody would notice, because nothing fails.
* An override is typed by a person, at a moment, after reading
artifacts/modernization_report.html. That is what the gate is for.
* CloudTrail records who ran it. An env var records nothing.
The task role for the agent must NOT have ecs:RunTask on this family.
The agent cannot be permitted to invoke its own approval, and IAM is where
that is actually enforced rather than merely intended.
